title: 和外婆一起看电影的下午
title_en: Sunday Afternoons at the Cinema with Grandma
summary_zh: 每个月的一个星期天，我都和外婆去她家附近的老电影院。她笑得太大声，全场都回头看——后来我也跟着笑了。读完你能用一般现在时、一般过去时和现在完成时讲一个家庭小习惯。
body: Every month, Grandma and I go to the cinema on a Sunday afternoon. It is a small, old cinema near her flat. The seats are red, and the floor is a little sticky. She always chooses the film. Sometimes it is a cartoon, and sometimes it is an old film. Last month we watched a funny film about a dog who wanted to be a singer. Grandma laughed so loudly that people turned around. I was embarrassed, but then I started laughing too. After the film, we always go to the café next door. We drink hot chocolate and talk about our favourite parts. She remembers films from when she was young, and she tells me about them. I have learned a lot about her life this way. These afternoons are the best part of my month.

expressions.note: every day / week / month 说固定的习惯。
She turned around when I called her name.
The shop next door sells bread.
We often talk about our school days.
I learn new words this way.

knowledge.explanation: 一般现在时加 always，说一直以来的习惯；主语是第三人称单数，所以 choose 加 s。

knowledge.quote: Last month we watched a funny film about a dog who wanted to be a singer.
knowledge.explanation: Last month 是过去的时间，所以用一般过去时 watched 和 wanted（规则动词加 -ed）。

knowledge.quote: I have learned a lot about her life this way.
knowledge.explanation: 现在完成时 have learned 说“到现在为止”的收获，不强调具体哪一天。

speaking: 用 1 分钟说说：你和家里人有没有一个固定一起做的事？上一次做的时候发生了什么？用上 every month 和 talk about。
writing: 用 50–70 词写一段话，介绍你和家人或朋友的一个小习惯，至少用一个一般过去时的句子和一个现在完成时的句子。

task.prompt: 仿照这句，用 … so loudly / so fast that … 写一句话，说一件让你印象深刻的小事。
task.model: Grandma laughed so loudly that people turned around.
